entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a bang as a smoke grenade..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a bang as a smoke grenade clattered through the window, releasing a plume of thick gray fog.

entries.title: Narrator: "The guests barely had time to react..."
entries.dialogueText: The guests barely had time to react before the windows shattered in unison, and the skylight above burst apart in a shower of glass.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azaro soldiers descended from the c..."
entries.dialogueText: Azaro soldiers descended from the ceiling on ropes while others entered through the broken windows.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sound of cracking glass rang th..."
entries.dialogueText: The sound of cracking glass rang through the room as the skylight above shattered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With ruthless efficiency, Palantor..."
entries.dialogueText: With ruthless efficiency, Palantor Security Solutions descended on ropes, landing with a series of solid thuds. They moved like clockwork.

entries.dialogueText: As we reached the door, Titus was hit. He fell to his knees, still firing, blood spreading across his uniform.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The future I envision for Rizia do..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future I envision for Rizia does not include rogue actors seeking to reshape it to their own ends."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've challenged the very stabili..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've challenged the very stability of this nation by asserting yourselves beyond the sphere of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia has no room for power-hungry..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has no room for power-hungry prats who think they can outshine the Crown, nor will I allow such a situation to fester."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let’s bring this farce to an end.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let’s bring this farce to an end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reckoning begins now.""
entries.dialogueText: "The reckoning begins now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The time for talk is over.""
entries.dialogueText: "The time for talk is over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now witness the true power of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now witness the true power of the Crown."

entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, Servio and the other Wruhec'..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, Servio and the other Wruhec's Guardians immediately swung their guns toward the newcomers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without warning, a commotion erupte..."
entries.dialogueText: Without warning, a commotion erupted from the main hall as another group of armed men rushed inside, weapons drawn and ready.

entries.dialogueText: A cacophony of competing commands filled the room. All of the nobles cowered, their faces etched with terror.

entries.title: Narrator: "Guns pointed at near point-blank ra..."
entries.dialogueText: Guns pointed at near point-blank range, each side daring the other to make the first move. Then the mounting tension was shattered.

entries.dialogueText: A catering staff member, trembling with fear, dropped a serving tray. The crash triggered an instantaneous eruption of gunfire.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bodies fell almost simultaneously -..."
entries.dialogueText: Bodies fell almost simultaneously -- from both sides.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Titus take a hit to his side,..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Titus take a hit to his side, but he dove for cover, returning fire with ruthless efficiency.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Chaos engulfed the room. Lights exp..."
entries.dialogueText: Chaos engulfed the room. Lights exploded as muzzle flashes sliced through the darkness in frantic bursts, and the gunfire soon spilled into the library's main hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't remember seeking cover, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't remember seeking cover, but I somehow found myself behind a table, the world a blur of sound and motion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without warning, Titus, bleeding fr..."
entries.dialogueText: Without warning, Titus, bleeding from his side, yanked me to my feet.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You need to get out! Now. I'll hol..."
entries.dialogueText: "You need to get out! Now. I'll hold them back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't argue."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't argue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus positioned himself as a shiel..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus positioned himself as a shield, firing and fighting.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not going anywhere!""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going anywhere!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A security officer charged, but Tit..."
entries.dialogueText: A security officer charged, but Titus dropped him with a combination of gunfire and brutal hand-to-hand combat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few catering attendants were grab..."
entries.dialogueText: A few catering attendants were grabbed, forced to their knees, and bound.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus stood with a few other Guardi..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus stood with a few other Guardians, weapons leveled at the stunned nobles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Guardians were relentless as th..."
entries.dialogueText: The Guardians were relentless as they secured the room with aggressive efficiency, blocking every possible escape route.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Guards formed a tight line, blo..."
entries.dialogueText: The Guards formed a tight line, blocking every exit with unwavering precision.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room was silent but for the cru..."
entries.dialogueText: The room was silent but for the crunch of broken glass beneath their boots.

entries.dialogueText: "Titus! What the hell are you doing?!"

entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Stay seated, Hugo.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Stay seated, Hugo.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus raised his weapon."
entries.dialogueText: Titus raised his weapon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus raised his firearm."
entries.dialogueText: Titus raised his firearm.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Stay where you are!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Stay where you are!”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Everyone stay where you are!""
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone stay where you are!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They shifted uncomfortably, casting..."
entries.dialogueText: They shifted uncomfortably, casting fearful glances at each other but remaining in place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus raised his gun."
entries.dialogueText: Titus raised his gun.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Sit down, Hugo.""
entries.dialogueText: “Sit down, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The smoke thickened, wrapping the r..."
entries.dialogueText: The smoke thickened, wrapping the room in a dense haze as the special forces moved with surgical precision.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Catering staff were seized and boun..."
entries.dialogueText: Catering staff were seized and bound, their wrists tied tight as the operatives worked quickly, leaving no corner unchecked.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I am.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room fell silent as the mercena..."
entries.dialogueText: The room fell silent as the mercenaries stood firmly at the door, cutting off all chances of escape.

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion! For God's sake, do something!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus lifted his firearm."
entries.dialogueText: Titus lifted his firearm.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mercenaries moved quickly, grab..."
entries.dialogueText: The mercenaries moved quickly, grabbing the catering attendants who remained standing, their bindings precise and professional.

entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Sit down!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sit down!”

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Captain! Do something!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, already in the room, watched..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, already in the room, watched them with a cool, almost detached expression.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: "“Titus! Do something!""
entries.dialogueText: “Titus! Do something!"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Captain! What in God’s name do you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain! What in God’s name do you think you’re doing?!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know about your plot against the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know about your plot against the Crown. If you have any sense, admit your guilt now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Having just learned of your betray..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having just learned of your betrayal, know this... Rizia's future has no room for traitors who aim to bend it to their own will."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've challenged the very stabili..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've challenged the very stability of this nation by asserting yourselves beyond the sphere of the Crown -- a betrayal I've only just uncovered."

entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and his men, along with the s..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and his men, along with the soldiers, immediately swung their guns toward the newcomers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and his men, along with the m..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and his men, along with the mercenaries, immediately swung their guns toward the newcomers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Run. My only option. Or was it?"
entries.dialogueText: Run. My only option. Or was it?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From the corner of my eye, I spotte..."
entries.dialogueText: From the corner of my eye, I spotted Lucita and motioned for her to follow.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But seeing her close proximity to t..."
entries.dialogueText: But seeing her close proximity to the House guards, I realized she couldn’t, so I pressed on.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't have to tell me twice!""
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to tell me twice!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you crazy? There's no way I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you crazy? There's no way I'm following you into that!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm sorry sir, but you don't have..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry sir, but you don't have a choice!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus grabbed me by the arm, taking..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus grabbed me by the arm, taking me with him. He positioned himself as a shield as he fought and fired as we pressed ahead.
